notes.sv: För svenska medborgare som sökt till en skola utomlands via Blueberry. Ansökan mailas med ett brev om skolval, studiemål och ekonomisk situation. Vinnaren utses 15 december.
notes.en: For Swedish citizens who applied to a school abroad through Blueberry. Applications are emailed with a letter on the choice of school, study goals and financial situation. The winner is announced on 15 December.
